description: This file defines constants, types, and functions related to model configurations and catalog entries for an AI system, including model costs, catalog entries, and resolution functions.

methods.name: toModelDefinition
methods.description: Converts a catalog entry into a model definition configuration.

methods.name: buildXaiModelDefinition
methods.description: Builds the default XAI model definition based on the catalog.

methods.name: buildXaiCatalogModels
methods.description: Returns an array of all catalog model definitions.

methods.name: resolveXaiCatalogEntry
methods.description: Resolves a model ID string to a specific model definition configuration, with special handling for certain prefixes and names.
